In the spec at spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb:24 ('requires embed_by_username'), only `embed_by_username` is stubbed to nil while `feed_polling_enabled?` retains its default of false (site_settings.yml: `feed_polling_enabled: false`), so the && short-circuits and embed_by_username is never consulted — the test passes vacuously and doesn't actually verify what its name claims. Same issue applies to the feed_polling_url test. Th

adjudication.rationale: In Jobs::PollFeed#execute, poll_feed is only called if SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled? && SiteSetting.feed_polling_url.present? && SiteSetting.embed_by_username.present?. In spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb, the test `it "requires embed_by_username"` only stubs `embed_by_username` to nil and does not stub `feed_polling_enabled?` to true nor provide a non-blank `feed_polling_url`. Given site_settings.yml sets feed_polling_enabled default to false, the guard will short-circuit on `feed_polling_enabled?` and never consult `embed_by_username`, making the test vacuous as the finding claims.
